profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | System Design, Backend Platforms & APIs
profile.summary:
Principal / Staff Software Engineer with a strong track record of designing and evolving enterprise-grade systems across distributed architectures. I specialize in system design, backend platforms, and API development, with hands-on experience building systems using TypeScript and GraphQL, backed by Golang, C#, Java, and SQL.

I focus on translating ambiguous problem spaces into clear, scalable technical solutions, applying sound architectural principles while balancing long-term maintainability with business impact. I use AI-assisted workflows as a design and reasoning aid to accelerate planning, explore tradeoffs, and improve solution quality—while maintaining strong engineering judgment and ownership.

Passionate about shaping technical direction, improving developer workflows, and mentoring engineers to raise the bar across teams.
